semantic_content.interpretation: This is a minimum-detectable-effect analysis, not observed post-hoc power and not an equivalence test. A null minimum detectable odds ratio means that discreteness prevents 80% power at any effect size.
semantic_content.method: Conditional exact two-sided binomial power given the observed number of informative (discordant or non-tied) pairs. The 0.0125 threshold is a conservative Bonferroni sensitivity benchmark for each four-test family; it is not presented as the variable Holm rejection boundary.

any_recorded_discrepancy_sensitivity.formula: is_any_recorded_discrepancy ~ log_ai_vol + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

semantic_content.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_ai_vol + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

nonlinear_sensitivity.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ cr(log_rho, df=3, constraints='center') + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

orthogonal_scale_difference_sensitivity.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_volume_scale + log_volume_difference + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

predictive_validation.pooled_metrics_caution: Pooled held-out predictions combine repository folds with different prevalence and score calibration; macro and per-fold metrics are reported.

ratio_parameterization_sensitivity.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_rho + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

repository_fixed_effect_inference_cohort.reason: Repository fixed effects are estimated only where the outcome varies within repository; single-outcome repositories otherwise produce separated nuisance intercepts.

artifact_excluded.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_ai_artifact_excluded_vol + log_gold_artifact_excluded_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

comment_excluded.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_ai_comment_excluded_vol + log_gold_comment_excluded_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

hunk_counts.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_hunks_ai + log_hunks_gold + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

source_only.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_ai_source_vol + log_gold_source_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

test_only.developer_term_status: not estimable: developer test-only volume is constant zero in the locked cohort
test_only.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_ai_test_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo, Treatment(reference='django/django'))

semantic_content.cohort_definition: all officially resolved trajectories with packaged patch fields; the explicit empty patch is retained as zero volume

system_metadata_boundary.shared_model_claim: The upstream artifact names all three configurations as Claude 3.5 Sonnet variants, but it does not establish identical snapshot, sampling temperature, token budget, or candidate-selection policy.

prohibited_inputs: developer-test outcome label during feature extraction

model.preprocessing: median imputation and standardization fitted within each training fold

semantic_content.scope: zero-execution, agent-final-diff-only lexical and path baseline

validation.scheme: leave one repository out; pool all held-out predictions

all_cohort_gee.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ file_mismatch_10pct + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo)
all_cohort_gee.label: file-set mismatch (per 10 percentage points)

all_cohort_gee.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_agent_only_files + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo)
all_cohort_gee.label: log(1 + agent-only files)

all_cohort_gee.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ log_gold_only_files + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo)
all_cohort_gee.label: log(1 + developer-only files)

all_cohort_gee.formula: is_full_suite_failure ~ artifact_like_agent_only + log_gold_vol + C(tool, Treatment(reference='OpenHands')) + C(repo)
all_cohort_gee.label: artifact-like agent-only path

matching.method: 1:1 without-replacement minimum-total-distance assignment within exact tool and repository strata; distance on log developer volume plus a small developer-file-count penalty

matching_robustness.interpretation: Exploratory design sensitivity; raw p-values are reported without treating alternative matching specifications as new hypotheses.

semantic_content.design: Issue-level failure-minus-control contrasts among issues containing both outcome states. Agent rows are averaged within outcome and issue before inference, so each issue receives equal weight.
semantic_content.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment across four structural features

semantic_content.limitation: The audit does not execute SWE-bench environments or developer tests and cannot verify environment fidelity, flaky-test handling, or behavioral labels.
semantic_content.recommended_independent_campaign: Re-execute all 68 inherited functionality-positive records, or a preregistered tool-by-repository stratified sample, using the upstream environment protocol.

purpose: Portable verification metadata for reviewed release-time Linux analysis results. The public archive does not contain the precomputed result files.

verification_policy.json_csv: Accept an exact byte hash, a canonical structured-content hash, or a schema-preserving semantic comparison with rtol=1e-7 and atol=1e-10 for numeric values.
verification_policy.pdf: Require a nontrivial valid PDF artifact. Numerical values plotted in figures are verified through companion JSON/CSV results.
verification_policy.png: Require a nontrivial PNG with the release-time dimensions. Numerical values are verified through companion JSON/CSV results.
